evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and updates RPC argument handling in `src/rpc/net.cpp`.
rationale: Fixes a signed integer overflow in `setban` argument handling where extreme relative ban times silently drop bans while reporting success. BanMan computes expiration as `GetTime() + bantime` using signed 64-bit integers, where overflow causes the ban to wrap negative and be treated as already expired, triggering a UBSan runtime error on extreme inputs.
